name: LLM Privacy Challenge
description: The NeurIPS 2024 LLM Privacy Challenge addresses privacy risks in Large Language Models (LLMs) by focusing on identifying vulnerabilities (Red Team) and developing defenses (Blue Team).

cr:input.name: Synthetic Private Data
cr:input.description: Synthetic datasets designed to mimic real-world private information without compromising individual privacy. For example, private data such as names and email addresses in datasets like Enron are replaced with randomly generated strings while maintaining realistic formats.
cr:input.encodingFormat: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset encoding format]
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset download URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predictions include either extracted sensitive information (Red Team) or outputs demonstrating the effectiveness of privacy defenses (Blue Team).

field.name: extracted_information
field.description: Sensitive information extracted by the Red Team, such as private names or email addresses. Example: 'John Doe, john.doe@example.com'.

field.name: defense_effectiveness
field.description: Effectiveness of the Blue Team's defense mechanisms, measured as a reduction in attack success rate. Example: 0.85 (85% reduction).

cr:evaluation.notes: Attack Accuracy measures the success rate of extracting sensitive information (Red Team) or the effectiveness of defenses in reducing this rate (Blue Team). Efficiency evaluates resource usage (e.g., tokens, queries, or computational overhead). Model Effectiveness ensures the LLM's utility is not significantly degraded by defenses.
